in_marathi.name: Dwarakadaas
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Dwaraka
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dwarakadaas हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dwarakadaas is derived from Sanskrit. It is a compound name, where 'Dwaraka' refers to the ancient city of Lord Krishna and 'daas' means servant or devotee. This name signifies one who is devoted to Lord Krishna and resides in Dwaraka.
